notes: The first name, «أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه», is the work's compiler (al-Saduq) heading his own chain: not written (owner ruling 1); the first written link is his father «أبي»
«قالوا: فعن حذيفة...» are Ali's answers about other Companions inside the same saying, not new isnads
